final:
def rotl8(x: uint8, k: int) -> uint8:
    """Rotate x left by k bits (k in 0..7); the high bits wrap around to the low end."""
    pre k >= 0 and k <= 7
    ex rotl8(wrap_as[uint8](129), 1) == wrap_as[uint8](3)
    ex rotl8(wrap_as[uint8](1), 0) == wrap_as[uint8](1)
    ex rotl8(wrap_as[uint8](1), 7) == wrap_as[uint8](128)
    r = int(x)
    return wrap_as[uint8]((r << k) | (r >> (8 - k)))
